John, saw Phosphorus just got acquired by Dragos and is folding into a much bigger industrial cyber platform.

Integrations like that usually mean more in-market accounts across the Central region than the team can touch while everything settles, and that is where deals stall. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Phosphorus off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Phosphorus needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
